Firdaus, Taj Krishna — Hyderabad (2018).

Menus for the hotel's Awadhi fine-diner, built like a heritage book: watercolour-washed monuments of the Deccan — the Charminar, the Buddha at Hussain Sagar, Golconda fort — printed on aged paper, a gilt 'Firdaus' script on the cover, and pink-jali bound covers for the physical set (main, beverage, alfresco and paired menus).

Menu design & identity — Anirudh Kapoor. A·58.
